newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian 182-day T-bill rate falls to 9.63 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian 182-day T-bill rate falls to 9.63 pct.

text.p: The average yield on 182-day Lithuanian Treasury bills fell to 9.63 percent from 9.95 percent at auction on Tuesday, the central bank said.
All amounts are in millions of litas.
MATURITY AVG YIELD LAST WEEK MIN/MAX ISSUE BID SOLD
The settlement date for today's auction is January 24 and the bills mature on July 25.
The next auctions are on January 27 when 30 million litas of 365-day paper will be offered and on January 28 when 50 million litas of 91-day paper will be auctioned.
